job.title: Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant (SF B2B Commerce Cloud exp mandatory)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Senior Consultant | B2B Commerce, REST APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platform solutions, API integrations, and architecture mapping for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, REST web services, and seamless PIM/ERP/MDM data flows. SAP Certified Developer experienced in business requirement analysis, gap analysis, solution design, and AI-assisted delivery in agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant (SF B2B Commerce Cloud exp mandatory)
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of experience delivering robust enterprise e-commerce platforms and techno-functional integration solutions for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Senior Technical Consultant role at Salesforce. My background combines deep hands-on backend expertise in Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs with functional requirements engineering and solution design for complex B2B commerce ecosystems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting & Solution Design
bullets.text: Analyzed complex business requirements, translated functional goals into architecture specifications, and led solution mapping across global e-commerce deployments.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and optimized RESTful APIs and data pipelines linking PIM, ERP (SAP ERP), and MDM systems (Profisee), resolving critical technical bottlenecks across cross-functional teams.

bullets.label: Headless & B2B Commerce Capabilities
bullets.text: Developed headless OCC APIs, customized B2B product catalogs, pricing engines, customer account structures, and order management systems for enterprise-scale platforms.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international stakeholders, conducted code reviews, accelerated documentation and delivery using generative AI tools, and provided ongoing production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my e-commerce integration expertise will benefit Salesforce clients.

tailoring.why_company: Salesforce is the global benchmark for customer success and digital transformation. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, B2B architecture, and techno-functional consulting experience to Salesforce to help clients build resilient, high-performing commerce ecosystems. Salesforce's commitment to innovation and seamless enterprise integration aligns perfectly with my background in end-to-end data flows and client solution design.
tailoring.motivation_short: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years of experience in Java, B2B/B2C commerce, and PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Eager to leverage strong solution design and requirements analysis skills to deliver successful enterprise commerce implementations for Salesforce clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I am an E-Commerce Technical Consultant with 5+ yrs delivering enterprise B2B platform integrations, Java REST APIs, and solution designs for Rockwell Automation & Shell. I'd love to bring my expertise to Salesforce. Available from 16.12.2026 (work permit valid).
tailoring.offer: I will immediately contribute to enterprise client success by translating complex business requirements into high-quality technical solution designs and API integrations. My background in PIM/ERP synchronization and headless architecture ensures rapid value delivery across client commerce implementations.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant role. I bring over 5 years of experience as a techno-functional e-commerce consultant, delivering complex B2B commerce architectures, REST APIs, and PIM/ERP integrations for clients such as Rockwell Automation and Shell. Salesforce's leadership in digital transformation makes this role an ideal match for my background in solution design and client delivery. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
